image.alt: White icons for lighting, music, and schedules appear on a long natural-wood mui Board mounted on a white wall as a finger touches the center control.

slides.text:
What if a smart-home screen
were hidden in wood?

mui Board Gen 2 places information and controls inside a natural-wood panel. Its display appears only when needed; the rest of the time, the interface remains in the room like a piece of furniture.

image.alt: Small white icons glow on a long wooden mui Board while a hand touches the center control, showing an interface that appears only when needed.

slides.text:
What a product looks like when off
is part of the experience

mui Board lights up only when information is needed. When unused, the display turns off and the wooden surface blends into the room. It proposes that a smart-home device need not always show a bright screen or app icon.

The interface has not disappeared. __Its visual weight in everyday life has been reduced__.

image.alt: Three wooden mui Board interfaces display controls for lighting, music, and appliances on a white background, showing multiple household states on one surface.

slides.text:
Move repeated tasks
outside the phone

The panel can show weather, family schedules, and timers, exchange handwritten or voice messages, and control lights, air conditioning, and Wi-Fi speakers.

The point is not to add more functions. It places brief, repeated actions on a particular surface so people encounter __fewer detours through the phone and its unrelated stimuli__.

image.alt:
Matter brings many devices
to one place

slides.text:
Matter brings many devices
to one place

Gen 2 is a Matter controller that connects devices from different manufacturers. Features shown by mui Lab in 2024 included control of lights, thermostats, blinds, and curtains, along with handwritten and voice messages, news, weather, music, and door locks.

The purpose of connection is not a longer control menu. It is __finishing repeated household actions quickly on one surface__.

image.alt: The Calm Tech Certified mark and check symbol appear in black on a white background, indicating mui Board Gen 2's certification.

slides.text:
The screen was not removed.
It was moved to the right place.

mui Board Gen 2 is Calm Tech Certified™. Its wood material, display that appears only when needed, and short gestures move technology from the center of attention to the periphery of domestic life.

Connected devices, services, and a setup app do not vanish. The value of this case is not ‘screenlessness,’ but __the possibility of separating everyday interactions from the smartphone__.

image.alt:
Without opening your phone,
what would you want __the place called home__
to tell you?

slides.text:

caption.body: mui Board Gen 2 does not turn the smart home into another collection of apps. It moves repeated controls onto a wooden surface within the home. Information appears only when needed and otherwise recedes into the furniture. Connectivity does not disappear, but brief actions that once required opening a phone can end at a specific place. That is what makes the product a useful Calm Technology case.
